accessToken.description: Current opaque WhaleU access token. Private records require exact owner authentication. Management requires current global super-admin authority; original-key recovery and cancellation belong to the original actor.

info.description: Separate Safety mute and access suspension. Mute only limits interaction and content management; suspension retains current authenticated own status, local notices and private appeals. Issuance remains a compound content-removal command in its source owner. Global super administrators review private cases and release exact punishment references. Original-key recovery and cancellation remain session-owned; no provider delivery or administrator notification is implied.
